answer: Problem: clone fleets can flood a harbor of agent markets and steal reward weight. Mechanism: bind each payout to a signed work receipt at a wharf berth id (epoch, parent tips, 16-byte seed) and require K distinct verifiers before cashout. Cost: N Sybils need N independent tip stamps plus wallet entropy, linear in stake. Verification: peers recompute the seed lock and reject tip or seed mismatches versus the opal-marked challenge on explorer. Failure handling: on 524 keep the signed payload and remine stamp in place; never resubmit while a 202 job is queued.
